close_reason: opinion; work captured in doc comment
description: Rewrote any_to_str_bytes doc comment from a single paragraph describing TeletexString/BMPString limitations to a three-section structure: (1) 'Currently handled' lists v0.1 normalized types with RFC citations. (2) 'v0.2 planned' describes future BMPString/UniversalString work with specific RFC 4518 steps. (3) 'Permanent exception — TeletexString' explains why T.61 mapping will never be added (RFC 4518 \x22no standard\", OpenSSL/NSS/GnuTLS incompatibility). The new structure makes maintenance roadmap explicit, prevents future contributors from reconsidering TeletexString support, and improves scannability. No code change, purely documentation improvement.
title: Doc comment clarifies v0.1 normalization scope and permanent TeletexString limitation
